translations.idiomatic: On the full moon of the seventh month, generals, vice presidents, and others presided at the sacrifice; on new moon, full moon, and death anniversaries, the chief steward holding the seal presided, performing three kneelings and nine kowtows.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，命宗室輔國將軍等六人徙駐瀋陽，給田廬，歲時致祀。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong, six Banner nobles including fugu jiangjun were ordered to move and be stationed at Shenyang, given fields and dwellings, to perform seasonal sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1, six Banner nobles including fugu jiangjun were ordered to move and be stationed at Shenyang, given fields and dwellings, to perform seasonal sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 二年，諭改朔、望承祭貝勒、公、大臣番行。

translations.literal: In the second year, an edict ordered that new and full moon receiving sacrifice be changed to beile, dukes, and ministers in rotation.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, an edict ordered that presiding at new- and full-moon sacrifices be changed to beile, dukes, and ministers serving in rotation.

sentences.zh: 復慮儀節不齊，增贊禮郎二人導引退，仍不贊。

translations.literal: Again fearing uneven ceremonial procedure, two ritual acolytes were added to guide entry and withdrawal, still without vocal prompting.
translations.idiomatic: Again fearing uneven ceremonial procedure, two ritual acolytes were added to guide entry and withdrawal, still without vocal prompting.

sentences.zh: 三年清明，謁世宗泰陵。

translations.literal: In the third year at Qingming, Shizong's Tailing was visited.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year at Qingming, Shizong's Tailing was visited.

sentences.zh: 六年，定三陵四時大饗。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, the four seasonal great feasts of the three tombs were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, the four seasonal great feasts of the three tombs were fixed.

sentences.zh: 忌辰祭饗，題派移駐將軍二人行禮。

translations.literal: For death-anniversary sacrifice feasts, two stationed generals were specially assigned to perform the rites.
translations.idiomatic: For death-anniversary sacrifice feasts, two stationed generals were specially assigned to perform the rites.

sentences.zh: 七年，增置三陵爵墊，備禮儀。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, wine-cup mats for the three tombs were added to complete the ritual accoutrements.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, wine-cup mats for the three tombs were added to complete the ritual accoutrements.

sentences.zh: 八年，定謁陵如太廟親祀儀，載入儀注。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, tomb visitation as at the Great Temple personal sacrifice was fixed and entered in the ritual regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, tomb visitation rites modeled on personal sacrifice at the Great Temple were fixed and entered in the ritual regulations.

sentences.zh: 已，奉皇太后謁祖陵，禮節准康熙時例。

translations.literal: Thereafter, escorting the empress dowager to visit the ancestral tombs—the ceremonial details followed the Kangxi-period model.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, when escorting the empress dowager to visit the ancestral tombs, the ceremonial details followed the Kangxi-period model.

sentences.zh: 自後三謁皆如之。

translations.literal: From then on, all three visits followed this.
translations.idiomatic: From then on, all three visits followed this model.

sentences.zh: 四十三年秋，先後謁永陵、福陵，因諭：「睠懷遼瀋舊疆，再三周曆，心儀舊緒，蘄永勿諼。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the forty-third year, Yongling and Fuling were visited in succession; an edict was issued: "Cherishing the old lands of Liaoning and Shenyang, I have toured them again and again; my heart turns to the old founding thread—I pray it may never be forgotten.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the forty-third year, Yongling and Fuling were visited in succession; an edict was issued: "Cherishing the old lands of Liaoning and Shenyang, I have toured them again and again; my heart turns to the founding legacy—I pray it may never be forgotten.

sentences.zh: 夫奕昇平景運，皆昔日艱難開創所貽。

translations.literal: For this flourishing age of peace and splendid fortune—all were bequeathed by the hard founding of former days.
translations.idiomatic: This flourishing age of peace and splendid fortune was all bequeathed by the arduous founding of former days.

sentences.zh: 後世子孫，當覽原巘而興思，拜松楸而感悟。

translations.literal: Later generations and descendants should, viewing the high hills, stir thought; bowing before pines and cypresses, gain insight.
translations.idiomatic: Later generations should, gazing upon the high hills, stir their thoughts; bowing before the pines and cypresses, be moved to reflection.

sentences.zh: 默念天眷何以久膺，先澤何以善繼。

translations.literal: Silently consider: why has Heaven's favor been long received? How may ancestral grace be well continued?
translations.idiomatic: Silently reflect on why Heaven's favor has been so long received, and how ancestral grace may be well continued.

sentences.zh: 知守成之難，兢業無墜。

translations.literal: Knowing the difficulty of preserving what is achieved, be diligent and let nothing fall.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing the difficulty of preserving what has been achieved, be diligent and let nothing fail.

sentences.zh: 庶熙洽之盛，億萬斯年。

translations.literal: Then may the flourishing harmony endure for ten thousand myriad years.
translations.idiomatic: Then may this flourishing harmony endure for ten thousand myriad years.

sentences.zh: 不然，輕故都，憚遠涉。

translations.literal: Otherwise, treating the old capital lightly, dreading the long journey.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise, treating the old capital lightly and dreading the long journey.

sentences.zh: 或偶詣祖陵，漠不動心，視同覽古，是忘本也。

translations.literal: Or making only occasional visits to the ancestral tombs, unmoved at heart, viewing it as sightseeing antiquity—this is forgetting one's roots.
translations.idiomatic: Or making only occasional visits to the ancestral tombs, unmoved at heart, treating it as mere antiquarian sightseeing—this is forgetting one's roots.

sentences.zh: 盛京根本重地，發祥所自，後世不可不躬親閱歷，其毋負朕言！」

translations.literal: Mukden is the fundamental weighty place, the source of our rise; later generations cannot but personally experience it—do not fail my words!"
translations.idiomatic: Mukden is the fundamental heartland, the source of our rise; later generations must personally experience it—do not fail my words!"

sentences.zh: 嘉慶五年清明，詣昌瑞山謁高宗裕陵，先敷土，次大饗。

translations.literal: At Qingming in the fifth year of Jiaqing, Changrui Mountain was visited and Gaozong's Yuling; earth was spread first, then the great feast.
translations.idiomatic: At Qingming in Jiaqing 5, Changrui Mountain was visited and Gaozong's Yuling; earth was spread first, then the great feast.

sentences.zh: 陵寢官豫取潔土儲筐，俟帝如更衣次易縞素，執事從官素服，冠去纓，隨至方城。

translations.literal: Tomb officials beforehand took clean earth and stored it in baskets; awaiting the Emperor's arrival, he changed to hempen white at the dressing chamber; attending officials wore plain dress, crowns without tassels, and followed to the square enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: Tomb officials beforehand gathered clean earth and stored it in baskets; when the Emperor arrived he changed to plain white at the dressing chamber; attending officials wore plain dress with crowns without tassels, and followed to the square enclosure.

sentences.zh: 有司進黃布護履，帝納履，從臣亦如之，自東磴道升至寶城石欄東，陵寢大臣合土以筐，隨駕至敷土處跪進。

translations.literal: The relevant officials presented yellow cloth shoe covers; the Emperor put them on, followers likewise; ascending from the east ramp to the east of the precious mound stone balustrade, tomb ministers combined earth in baskets and, following the imperial carriage to the earth-spreading place, knelt and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant officials presented yellow cloth shoe covers; the Emperor put them on, and his followers did likewise; ascending from the east ramp to the east of the precious mound's stone balustrade, tomb ministers combined earth in baskets and, following the imperial carriage to the earth-spreading place, knelt and presented it.

sentences.zh: 帝拱舉，敷畢，授筐，降，脫履。

translations.literal: The Emperor received it with cupped hands, spread it, returned the basket, descended, and removed the shoe covers.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor received it with cupped hands, spread the earth, returned the basket, descended, and removed the shoe covers.

sentences.zh: 於是更袍服，冠綴纓，執事官俱易。

translations.literal: Thereupon robes were changed, crowns re-tasseled, and all attending officials likewise changed.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon robes were changed, crowns were re-tasseled, and all attending officials changed likewise.

sentences.zh: 禮臣請行大饗，帝詣隆恩殿行禮。

translations.literal: Ritual officials requested the great feast; the Emperor proceeded to Long'en Hall to perform the rites.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual officials requested the great feast; the Emperor proceeded to Long'en Hall to perform the rites.

sentences.zh: 讀祝，三獻。

translations.literal: The prayer was read; three presentations were made.
translations.idiomatic: The prayer was read; three presentations were made.

sentences.zh: 凡清明日謁陵敷土，在喪服期，帝親行。

translations.literal: Whenever on Qingming tomb was visited for earth-spreading, during the mourning-garment period the Emperor performed it in person.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever on Qingming the tomb was visited for earth-spreading, during the mourning-garment period the Emperor performed it in person.

sentences.zh: 十年，帝初謁永陵，御素服，詣啟運殿後階，三跪九拜，有司進奠幾，三拜三奠爵。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, the Emperor first visited Yongling, attired in plain white; proceeding to the rear steps of Qiyun Hall, three kneelings and nine kowtows; the relevant officials presented the offering table; three bows and three wine presentations.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, the Emperor first visited Yongling, attired in plain white; proceeding to the rear steps of Qiyun Hall, he performed three kneelings and nine kowtows; the relevant officials presented the offering table; three bows and three wine presentations followed.

sentences.zh: 訖，舉哀。

translations.literal: When finished, wailing was raised.
translations.idiomatic: When finished, wailing was raised.

sentences.zh: 翼日朝服行大饗。

translations.literal: The next day, in court dress, the great feast was performed.
translations.idiomatic: The next day, in court dress, the great feast was performed.

sentences.zh: 謁福陵、昭陵亦如之。

translations.literal: Visiting Fuling and Zhaoling was likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Visits to Fuling and Zhaoling followed the same rites.

sentences.zh: 後復以祭器乖誤，革盛京禮部侍郎世臣職。

translations.literal: Later, because sacrificial vessels were wrong, the hereditary minister vice president of the Mukden Board of Rites was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Later, because sacrificial vessels were incorrect, the hereditary minister vice president of the Mukden Board of Rites was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 因諭「豐沛舊都，大臣不應忘卻」。

translations.literal: An edict was issued: "The old capital like Feng and Pei—ministers should not forget it."
translations.idiomatic: An edict was issued: "Like Feng and Pei, the old capital—ministers should not forget it."

sentences.zh: 下其諭各公署，其重祀如此。

translations.literal: The edict was sent down to each yamen; such was the weight placed on sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: The edict was sent down to each yamen; such was the weight placed on sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 道光八年，謁裕陵、昌陵，軍機大臣隨入門，命著為例。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Daoguang, Yuling and Changling were visited; Grand Council ministers followed inside the gate—ordered to be made precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 8, Yuling and Changling were visited; Grand Council ministers followed inside the gate—this was ordered to be made precedent.

sentences.zh: 九年，奉皇太后詣盛京謁三陵，如儀。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, escorting the empress dowager to Mukden, the three tombs were visited according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, escorting the empress dowager to Mukden, the three tombs were visited according to ritual.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年謁東陵，五年謁西陵，孝貞皇后謁泰陵，陵寢女官為導，入門皆由左，至明樓前行禮，六肅三跪三拜。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng the Eastern Tombs were visited; in the fifth year the Western Tombs; Empress Xiaozhen visited Tailing; tomb female officials served as guides; all entered by the left; rites were performed before Minglou—six rounds of solemnity, three kneelings, three bows.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 1 the Eastern Tombs were visited; in Xianfeng 5 the Western Tombs; Empress Xiaozhen visited Tailing; tomb female officials served as guides; all entered by the left; rites were performed before Minglou—six rounds of solemnity, three kneelings, and three bows.

sentences.zh: 女官進奠幾，後三拜三奠爵，西饗舉哀。

translations.literal: Female officials presented the offering table; the empress three bows and three wine presentations; wailing was raised at the western side table.
translations.idiomatic: Female officials presented the offering table; the empress performed three bows and three wine presentations; wailing was raised at the western side table.

sentences.zh: 次謁昌陵、慕陵如初禮。

translations.literal: Next Changling and Muling were visited as at the initial rites.
translations.idiomatic: Next Changling and Muling were visited as at the initial rites.

sentences.zh: 同、光間悉依此行。

translations.literal: In the Tongzhi and Guangxu periods all followed this model.
translations.idiomatic: In the Tongzhi and Guangxu periods all followed this model.

sentences.zh: 凡孝陵、景陵以下，世宗曰泰陵，高宗裕陵，仁宗昌陵，宣宗慕陵，文宗定陵，穆宗惠陵，並在直隸易、遵化二州，稱東西陵，東陵鳳台山，封昌山；

translations.literal: For Xiaoling, Jingling, and below—Shizong's Tailing, Gaozong's Yuling, Renzong's Changling, Xuanzong's Muling, Wenzong's Dingling, Muzong's Huiling—all lay in Yi and Zunhua prefectures of Zhili, called the Eastern and Western Tombs; the Eastern Tombs at Fengtai Mountain, titled Chang Mountain;
translations.idiomatic: Below Xiaoling and Jingling—Shizong's Tailing, Gaozong's Yuling, Renzong's Changling, Xuanzong's Muling, Wenzong's Dingling, and Muzong's Huiling—all lay in Yi and Zunhua prefectures of Zhili, called the Eastern and Western Tombs; the Eastern Tombs at Fengtai Mountain were titled Chang Mountain;

sentences.zh: 西陵太平峪，封永寧山；

translations.literal: the Western Tombs at Taipingyu, titled Yongning Mountain;
translations.idiomatic: the Western Tombs at Taipingyu were titled Yongning Mountain;

sentences.zh: 並祀方澤。

translations.literal: all given collateral worship at the Altar of Earth.
translations.idiomatic: all were given collateral worship at the Altar of Earth.

sentences.zh: 設奉祀官，置莊園。

translations.literal: Sacrifice officials were established and estates placed.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifice officials were established and estates were established.

sentences.zh: 隆恩殿大饗用祝幣，其日燃明鐙，用牛一、羊二、尊四，帝、後同案位，設奉先制幣一，羹飯脯醢器十八，餅果器六十五。

translations.literal: Long'en Hall great feasts used prayer silks; that day bright lamps were lit; one ox, two sheep, four wine vessels were used; emperor and empress shared one table position; one ancestral-regulation silk was set; eighteen vessels for broth, rice, dried meat, and pickled meats; sixty-five vessels for cakes and fruit.
translations.idiomatic: Long'en Hall great feasts used prayer silks; that day bright lamps were lit; one ox, two sheep, and four wine vessels were used; the emperor and empress shared one table position; one ancestral-regulation silk was set out; eighteen vessels for broth, rice, dried meat, and pickled meats; and sixty-five vessels for cakes and fruit.

sentences.zh: 牲實俎，帛實筐。

translations.literal: Sacrificial animals filled the stands; silks filled the baskets.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial animals filled the stands; silks filled the baskets.

sentences.zh: 酒實尊，承以舟。

translations.literal: Wine filled the vessels, borne on trays.
translations.idiomatic: Wine filled the vessels, borne on trays.

sentences.zh: 疏布冪勺具。

translations.literal: Coarse cloth covers and ladles were provided.
translations.idiomatic: Coarse cloth covers and ladles were provided.

sentences.zh: 皇貴妃祔祀，則西旁東鄉，素帛一，減餅果十一器。

translations.literal: When an imperial noble consort was given collateral worship, on the west side facing east—one plain silk; cake and fruit reduced by eleven vessels.
translations.idiomatic: When an imperial noble consort was given collateral worship, on the west side facing east—one plain silk; cake and fruit vessels were reduced by eleven.

sentences.zh: 凡冬至暨慶典不舉哀。

translations.literal: Whenever at the winter solstice and celebratory occasions, wailing was not raised.
translations.idiomatic: At the winter solstice and on celebratory occasions, wailing was not raised.

sentences.zh: 遣官祭饗用朝服。

translations.literal: Dispatched officials for sacrifice feasts wore court dress.
translations.idiomatic: Officials dispatched for sacrifice feasts wore court dress.

sentences.zh: 升降自西階，出入皆門右。

translations.literal: Ascent and descent were by the west steps; entry and exit all by the right of the gate.
translations.idiomatic: Ascent and descent were by the west steps; entry and exit were all by the right of the gate.

sentences.zh: 皇子謁陵，至下馬碑降騎，至隆恩門外升左階。

translations.literal: When a prince visited tombs, at the dismount stele he descended from his horse; outside Long'en Gate he ascended the left steps.
translations.idiomatic: When a prince visited the tombs, at the dismount stele he descended from his horse; outside Long'en Gate he ascended the left steps.

sentences.zh: 三跪九拜，不贊，不奠酒。

translations.literal: Three kneelings and nine kowtows; no vocal prompting, no wine offering.
translations.idiomatic: Three kneelings and nine kowtows; no vocal prompting, no wine offering.

sentences.zh: 妃園寢設官如制，建饗殿，設神位。

translations.literal: Consort garden tombs had officials established as prescribed; sacrifice halls were built and spirit seats installed.
translations.idiomatic: Consort garden tombs had officials established as prescribed; sacrifice halls were built and spirit seats installed.

sentences.zh: 四時遣官尊酒，二跪六拜，不贊。

translations.literal: In the four seasons officials were dispatched with wine; two kneelings and six bows; no vocal prompting.
translations.idiomatic: In the four seasons officials were dispatched with wine; two kneelings and six bows; no vocal prompting.

sentences.zh: 出人殿左門。

translations.literal: Entry and exit were by the hall's left gate.
translations.idiomatic: Entry and exit were by the hall's left gate.

sentences.zh: 朔、望則奉祀官行禮。

translations.literal: On new and full moon days, sacrifice officials performed the rites.
translations.idiomatic: On new and full moon days, sacrifice officials performed the rites.

sentences.zh: 光緒間，帝謁西陵，詣庄順皇貴妃寢園，一跪三拜三奠酒。

translations.literal: During the Guangxu period, the Emperor visited the Western Tombs and went to Imperial Noble Consort Zhuangshun's garden tomb, performing one kneeling, three prostrations, and three libations of wine.
translations.idiomatic: During the Guangxu period, the Emperor visited the Western Tombs and went to Imperial Noble Consort Zhuangshun's garden tomb, performing one kneeling, three prostrations, and three libations of wine.

sentences.zh: 並諭禮臣，祭品儀節從優。

translations.literal: He also instructed the ritual officials that sacrificial offerings and ceremonial procedure should be treated with special generosity.
translations.idiomatic: He also instructed the ritual officials that sacrificial offerings and ceremonial procedure should receive preferential treatment.

sentences.zh: 是後清明、中元、冬至、忌辰遣王公致祭，餅果增至六十五器。

translations.literal: Thereafter, on Qingming, Zhongyuan, the winter solstice, and death anniversaries, princes were dispatched to perform sacrifice; cakes and fruits were increased to sixty-five vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, on Qingming, Zhongyuan, the winter solstice, and death anniversaries, princes were dispatched to sacrifice; cakes and fruits were increased to sixty-five vessels.

sentences.zh: 宣統初，德宗葬興隆峪，號崇陵。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xuantong, Dezong was buried at Xinglong Valley, styled Chongling.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xuantong, Dezong was buried at Xinglong Valley, and the tomb was named Chongling.

sentences.zh: 皇太子園寢與妃園寢同。

translations.literal: The crown prince's garden tomb followed the same regulations as consorts' garden tombs.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince's garden tomb followed the same regulations as consorts' garden tombs.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶間，帝親臨端慧皇太子園寢，三奠三爵，從臣隨行禮，每奠一拜。

translations.literal: During the Jiaqing period, the Emperor personally attended Crown Prince Duanhui's garden tomb, performing three libations and three goblets; attending ministers followed in the rites, one prostration at each libation.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jiaqing period, the Emperor personally attended Crown Prince Duanhui's garden tomb, performing three libations and three goblets; attending ministers followed in the rites, one prostration at each libation.

sentences.zh: 載其儀入會典雲。

translations.literal: Its rites were recorded in the Collected Statutes.
translations.idiomatic: These rites were recorded in the Collected Statutes.
